name: porcupine_costume
description: Doug's homemade porcupine suit (worn prop, 041 s071, s072): a round brown felt #5a4030 ball suit over his torso (x -112..112, y -144..64) with spray shading, covered in dark-based, cream-tipped quills that all point OUTWARD (a fringe round the edge plus quills sewn over the face), a grey front zipper with pull tab, a lighter felt collar bunched under the chin, and a short quill-covered tail out of the back at hip height. No quills within 16 units of the head circle: face and red cap fully visible; arms are inside the ball in `stand`, and the front arm pokes out in `thumbs_up`. Anchor = Doug's hips: list after Doug at the same x/y/scale. bbox about x -190..180, y -205..135.
